name: WSParameter
description: Represents a parameter defined for an Operation object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Use the Name property to specify or determine the string expression that identifies the name of an object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets the data type of the specified parameter. Read-only Integer.
